description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the Features interface, managing a collection of Feature objects with methods for modification, serialization, and retrieval.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatures
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the Features interface, managing a collection of Feature objects with methods for modification, serialization, and retrieval.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Returns a new empty ImmutableFeatures instance.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an ImmutableFeatures instance initialized with given features.

methods.name: getFeature
methods.description: Retrieves a feature by its ID, returning an Optional.

methods.name: setFeature
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with the specified feature set or replaced.

methods.name: removeFeature
methods.description: Returns a new Features instance with the specified feature removed.

methods.name: setDefinition
methods.description: Sets a feature's definition, creating or updating the feature.

methods.name: removeDefinition
methods.description: Removes the definition from a feature.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a specific property of a feature.

methods.name: removeProperty
methods.description: Removes a specific property from a feature.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if there are no features.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes features to a JsonObject with schema version and predicate filtering.
